subject: beodeul_town_wall

criteriaNotes.same_game: Wall face uses 3-4 step warm greys (c8c5ba/bcbbb1/99968c/86827f/54504e) with speckled large ashlar blocks and a dark 2b203f outline; red terracotta tower roofs reuse the house-roof red/orange with dotted tile texture. Next to the original half-timbered and stone houses it reads as the same chipset, and the block scale matches the stone walls in the reference market map. Minor: the outline is navy-purple (2b203f) where the houses use dark brown and the reference wall uses dark grey; the pinkish walkway brick (c2bca7/bcaaa0/9e8d83) is warmer than the reference's grey walkway. Neither breaks the set.
criteriaNotes.view_34: North wall shows its walkway plus the inner (south-facing) face with stairs. The south wall shows its walkway with the parapet on the front edge, then its outer face. West and east walls show only a 1-cell walkway with the parapet column on the outer edge, and their inner edges are outlined (3x x~95 and x~1345). The north end of the west-gap segment correctly shows a south end face (3x y~380-475); the south segment shows only top. Gatehouse tops show a back and front merlon row over a visible plane. Towers rise as front faces capped by the pyramid roof and drop ~2px below the wall base, so they project in front. No isometric side faces anywhere.
criteriaNotes.seamless_joins: FAIL. In the T-junction where a N-S spur joins the north wall from the south (parts-scene-1x x=128..143; kit-wall_parts-4x x~515-575, y~95-125), the spur's two outlines (2b203f at x=128 and x=143) and its light parapet blocks (x=129-132, x=139-142) start at row 24 and run through the parent walkway band (rows 23-31) up to the merlon row. The parent wall-walk is cut by two dark vertical lines and is blocked instead of merging; at 3x this shows as a ~24px double line notch. The mirrored T at the bottom right of kit-wall_parts (spur x~1410-1470 entering the south walkway y~1665-1700) has the same fault. Row 23 inside the spur (x=133-137) also switches to a7a7a1 instead of the parent's c2bca7, which leaves a visible colour seam. Everything else joins cleanly: corners, concave corner, end caps, gatehouse sides, tower sides, stairs and west gap. One minor issue: the south segment at the west gap starts at the road (1x y~192) without a top outline or lip.
criteriaNotes.gate_readable: At 1x the south gate shows a dark arch with portcullis teeth, a threshold shadow and the road continuing through and out below, so it reads open. The north gate is a full brown double door with iron bands that the road dead-ends into, so it reads closed. The west gap reads as an opening: the wall shows an end face and the cobble road runs straight through.
criteriaNotes.readability_1x: At 1x the whole reads clearly as a crenellated stone town wall with four red-roof towers and two gatehouses around the village. Wall face 2 cells vs house walls ~2 cells, towers ~6 cells tall: plausible scale. Stairs read as a lighter stepped strip on the north inner face.

fixes: T-junction (spur joining from the south into the north wall, parts-scene-1x x=128..143): stop the spur's outline pixels and side parapet blocks at the parent's face top (row 31/32). Don't draw them in rows 23-31. Instead, continue the parent walkway pattern (c2bca7/bcaaa0/9e8d83 brick rows) across x=128-143 so the two walkways merge into one open plane. Repaint row 23 x=133-137 from a7a7a1 to the parent's c2bca7 run.

Apply the same fix to the T entering the south wall from the north (kit-wall_parts-4x bottom right, spur x~1410-1470): end the spur's side outlines and parapet columns at the parent walkway's inner edge outline. Don't run them down to the front merlon row. Let the walkway plane continue under the junction.
minor: West-gap south segment (test-map-1x ~x17-31, y~192): add a 1px dark top outline plus a 1px light lip where the walkway meets the road, matching the outlined north end.
Outline colour 2b203f is cooler than the houses' dark-brown outlines; consider a slightly warmer dark (e.g. 2f2430) for closer harmony.
Walkway brick is pinker than the reference's grey walkway; a slight desaturation would sit closer to original Beodeul walls.
Stairs in kit-wall_ring sit directly against the west-wall corner (x~130); leaving one face cell, as in the test map, reads better.
